dedupe_keys.name: health indicator injury age sex specific emergency department visit rates by first nations status

description: Six Alberta injury health-indicator packages describe healthcare service-use rates per 100,000 population. Emergency-department measures include age-sex-specific and age-standardised rates by First Nations status, age-standardised rates for selected geographies, and age-standardised rates by detailed injury groupings. Hospital-separation measures cover First Nations status and detailed injury groupings. The named injury-indicator breakdowns are curated as one family with distinct native identities and denominators; they are not interchangeable tables. Native start dates are 1998 for five members and 1994 for the hospital-separation injury-grouping member, with no end dates. The latter package has a contradictory resource label naming emergency visits even though its title and description specify hospital separations; this remains unresolved. All descriptors point to distinct legacy indicator redirects. Download formats, exports and current operation are unknown. Geographic coverage is Alberta. Related Canadian and unified catalogue entries are metadata mirrors; their labels do not prove byte equivalence or complete coverage. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the Alberta package identity and descriptive metadata. It states Open Government Licence - Alberta and unrestricted access, while isopen is false. Actual source access, cost and payload contents remain unverified. No dataset, workbook, indicator result or document body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications are not stated.
